title: Orca Spirit Adventures Zodiac Whale Watching
specs: Peak whale watching season May through October with >95% success rate
Wildlife includes Transient (Bigg’s) Orcas, Humpback Whales, and Minke Whales

Please note: Zodiac tours are not offered to children under 6 years of age, persons under 4 feet tall, those who are pregnant, or those with neck or back problems Each tour lasts approximately 3 hours.
The maximum weight per single piece of luggage is 50 pounds.
ONE piece of government issued photo ID Example: Passport, Driver’s License, Provincial ID, Citizen Card, Permanent Resident Card.
Temporary Driver’s License can be used as photo ID even though there is no photo, but it is important to ensure the expiry date has not been surpassed.
NOTE: credit cards are NOT acceptable nor is anything else that is not issued by government The maximum weight per single piece of luggage is 25 pounds.
Any luggage over 25lbs will be sent over on a standby, space available basis, and charged at $2/ lb. directly to the passenger at check in.
Fraud Prevention Notice For your security, please bring a government-issued photo ID and the credit card used to book when you check in.
Open Vessel Tours require minimum height of 4 feet (120 cm)

blurb: Guests join 3-hour whale watching and wildlife tours on either open-air 12-passenger vessels or semi-covered vessels with indoor seating and washrooms. Tours run from April through October with a peak season from May to October. Full flotation suits are provided on open vessel tours, and naturalists are available on semi-covered vessel tours.
